function.name: check_calendar_availability
function.description: Checks the live Google Calendar for available 30-minute meeting slots with Tariq and the BrainCX solutions engineering team for a given date and timezone.

date.description: The date to check availability for in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2026-09-24').

timezone.description: The timezone of the caller, e.g., 'America/New_York', 'America/Los_Angeles', 'Europe/London', or 'Asia/Manila'. Defaults to 'America/New_York'.

time_preference.description: Optional preference for morning or afternoon slots.

function.name: create_calendar_booking
function.description: Creates a confirmed 30-minute discovery meeting on the live Google Calendar with Tariq and the BrainCX solutions team, and sends calendar invite with Google Meet link.

name.description: The full name of the visitor booking the meeting.

email.description: The verified email address of the visitor to send the calendar invite and confirmation.

datetime.description: The selected start date and time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-09-24T14:00:00Z' or '2026-09-24T10:00:00-04:00').

visitor_notes.description: Brief notes on the visitor's industry vertical (e.g. Higher Ed, Healthcare, Telecom) and current contact center situation.
